context: Ren reports a robotics deal to Hiroshi-boss.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business report; vocabulary (成立/ロボット/測定/出張/済み) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ロボットの契約が、成立しました。
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 出張は、無事に済んだかね?
lines.en: Did the business trip go smoothly?
lines.style: attentive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、出張は問題なく済みました。
lines.en: Yes, the trip was completed without issue.
lines.style: precise young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ロボットの精度は、測定したかね?
lines.en: Did you measure the robot's precision?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 測定済みで、基準を満たしています。
lines.en: It's measured and meets the standard.
lines.style: confident young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約成立で、生産を進められるな。
lines.en: With the deal concluded, we can advance production.
lines.style: satisfied boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 測定の報告書も、提出済みです。
lines.en: The measurement report is submitted too.
lines.style: reliable young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 成立おめでとう。次の出張も頼む。
lines.en: Congrats on the deal. I count on the next trip too.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
